style: 半写实插画风格，电影感光影，深蓝与墨绿色调的夜间工作台，青绿色和琥珀色的点光源，细节丰富，没有文字，没有logo，没有水印

scenes.name: hero_home
scenes.prompt: 深夜的创客工作台全景，桌上一块蓝色的小型微控制器开发板正亮着一颗绿色LED，旁边有示波器、电烙铁、面包板和一台笔记本电脑，屏幕发出微光，杜邦线散落，暖色台灯

scenes.name: mod0_setup
scenes.prompt: 刚拆开的电子开发套件摆在木质桌面上，一块蓝色微控制器开发板、一个小巧的USB烧录器、一捆彩色杜邦线、几个小传感器模块和面包板，包装盒半开，俯视构图，柔和台灯

scenes.name: mod1_blink
scenes.prompt: 微距特写，一块蓝色微控制器开发板上一颗绿色LED正在发光，光晕柔和，浅景深，背景是虚化的面包板和电阻，黑色桌面

scenes.name: mod2_talk
scenes.prompt: 笔记本电脑屏幕上滚动着一行行发光的终端日志，一根USB线从电脑连到桌上的一块小型开发板，开发板上有指示灯闪烁，夜间，蓝色屏幕光照亮桌面

scenes.name: mod3_sense
scenes.prompt: 面包板上插着温湿度传感器、光敏电阻和一块正在显示波形的小型OLED屏幕，连着一块蓝色微控制器开发板，杜邦线整齐，微距，柔和的青色屏幕光

scenes.name: mod4_time
scenes.prompt: 示波器屏幕上显示着一条清晰的绿色方波，旁边桌上放着一块微控制器开发板和探头，深色实验室，仪器指示灯，电影感

scenes.name: mod5_onion
scenes.prompt: 放大镜下一颗方形的微控制器芯片，可以看到细密的管脚，旁边摊开着厚厚的芯片参考手册，手册上有引脚图和寄存器表格，暖色台灯，深色木桌

scenes.name: mod6_capstone
scenes.prompt: 桌面上一个自制的桌面温湿度小站，小型OLED屏幕亮着，3D打印的白色外壳，旁边有一杯咖啡和一盆小绿植，清晨的窗光，温馨

scenes.name: lab_bench
scenes.prompt: 电子实验台俯视图，面包板、数字万用表、烙铁架、镊子、几块开发板和一盒整齐的电阻，工具排列整齐，深色防静电台面，顶部工作灯

scenes.name: journal_night
scenes.prompt: 深夜台灯下一本摊开的笔记本，手写的电路草图和笔记，旁边放着一块小型开发板和一支笔，一杯冒着热气的茶，温暖安静

scenes.name: prompts_ai
scenes.prompt: 一块半透明的全息屏幕悬浮在工作台上方，屏幕里是发光的电路图和代码，桌上有开发板和键盘，青色与紫色的光，未来感

npcs.name: npc_mentor
npcs.prompt: 四十岁左右的亚洲女性嵌入式工程师，短发，戴细框眼镜，穿深色工装夹克，胸前口袋插着一支笔，手里拿着一块蓝色的小型微控制器开发板，表情温和自信，微微笑

parts_style: 电子元件产品图，半写实插画风格，居中完整不裁切，纯正绿色平涂背景，背景没有阴影和渐变，柔和棚拍光，细节清晰，没有文字，没有logo，没有水印

parts.name: part_bluepill
parts.label: STM32 Blue Pill
parts.prompt: 一块蓝色的STM32F103C8T6最小系统开发板（俗称蓝药丸），俯视正上方视角，两排排针，板上有一颗方形黑色芯片、微型USB口、两个黄色跳线帽、一个复位按钮
parts.what: The star of the show. One STM32 chip plus the bare minimum around it, with two rows of header pins exposing the I/O

parts.name: part_stlink
parts.label: ST-Link V2 programmer
parts.prompt: 一个铝合金外壳的USB烧录器ST-Link V2，像U盘形状，一端是USB接口，另一端是10针排针，正面视角
parts.what: The tool that writes your program from the computer into the chip. Four wires: SWDIO, SWCLK, GND, 3.3V

parts.name: part_usb_serial
parts.label: USB-to-serial adapter (CH340)
parts.prompt: 一个小型USB转TTL串口模块，带CH340芯片，一端是USB-A接口，另一端有六根排针，板子上有一个小跳线帽，俯视
parts.what: Lets the board talk to your computer. Board TX goes to its RX, crossed over

parts.name: part_breadboard
parts.label: Breadboard
parts.prompt: 一块白色的半尺寸电子面包板，俯视正上方，密密的插孔排列整齐，两侧有红蓝电源轨
parts.what: Build circuits by plugging in wires, no soldering. The 5 holes in each column are connected

parts.name: part_led_red
parts.label: Red LED
parts.prompt: 一颗5毫米红色发光二极管，透明红色圆头，两根金属长脚一长一短，正面略俯视
parts.what: Light-emitting diode. Long leg is positive, short leg is negative, and it must have a resistor in series

parts.name: part_led_yellow
parts.label: Yellow LED
parts.prompt: 一颗5毫米黄色发光二极管，透明黄色圆头，两根金属长脚一长一短，正面略俯视
parts.what: Same as above, different color

parts.name: part_resistor_220
parts.label: 220Ω resistor
parts.prompt: 一只轴向引线的碳膜电阻，米色圆柱体，色环从左到右为红色、红色、棕色、金色，两端有长长的银色引脚，水平放置
parts.what: Limits current. Red-red-brown-gold = 220Ω, the standard partner for an LED

parts.name: part_resistor_10k
parts.label: 10kΩ resistor
parts.prompt: 一只轴向引线的碳膜电阻，米色圆柱体，色环从左到右为棕色、黑色、橙色、金色，两端有长长的银色引脚，水平放置
parts.what: Used as a pull-up. Brown-black-orange-gold = 10kΩ

parts.name: part_button
parts.label: Tactile push button
parts.prompt: 一个6x6毫米四脚轻触开关按键，黑色方形塑料按钮，四根金属弯脚，俯视略斜
parts.what: Conducts while pressed, opens when released. The four legs come in two connected pairs

parts.name: part_potentiometer
parts.label: Potentiometer
parts.prompt: 一个蓝色的可调电位器模块，顶部有白色旋钮，底部三根排针，正面略俯视
parts.what: A variable resistor. Turn the knob and the voltage on the middle pin follows; great for practicing ADC

parts.name: part_ldr
parts.label: Photoresistor (LDR)
parts.prompt: 一只光敏电阻LDR，圆形扁平的头部有蛇形金属纹路，两根长引脚，正面略俯视
parts.what: Brighter light, lower resistance. Use it to build a night light

parts.name: part_dht11
parts.label: DHT11 temperature & humidity sensor
parts.prompt: 一个蓝色方块状的DHT11温湿度传感器模块，蓝色塑料外壳上有网格状开孔，下方三根排针，正面视角
parts.what: Reads temperature and humidity over a single data wire. Your first time using a library someone else wrote

parts.name: part_oled
parts.label: 0.96" OLED display
parts.prompt: 一块0.96英寸的小型OLED显示屏模块，蓝色电路板，黑色屏幕上显示着一条青色波形线条，顶部四根排针（GND VCC SCL SDA），正面视角
parts.what: A small screen driven by two I2C wires, 128x64 pixels

parts.name: part_buzzer
parts.label: Buzzer
parts.prompt: 一个黑色圆柱形的有源蜂鸣器，顶部中间有一个小孔，底部两根引脚，正面略俯视
parts.what: Beeps when powered. With PWM you can play different pitches

parts.name: part_jumper
parts.label: Jumper wires
parts.prompt: 一小捆彩虹色的杜邦跳线，红黄绿蓝紫等颜色并排排列成扁平排线，两端是黑色塑料接头，斜放
parts.what: For wiring. Male ends go into the breadboard, female ends onto header pins

parts.name: part_usb_cable
parts.label: Micro USB cable
parts.prompt: 一根黑色的Micro USB数据线，一端是USB-A接头，另一端是Micro USB接头，线缆盘成一个松松的圈
parts.what: Powers the board and carries serial. Beware: some cables are charge-only and carry no data

parts.name: part_sg90
parts.label: SG90 servo
parts.prompt: 一个蓝色塑料外壳的SG90微型舵机，侧前方45度视角，顶部有白色十字形舵盘，机身侧面两个固定耳片，引出一根三色排线（棕红橙）带白色三针插头，旁边散落两个白色塑料舵盘配件
parts.what: A tiny motor that turns to an exact angle. Three wires: brown ground, red power, orange signal

parts.name: part_relay
parts.label: Relay module
parts.prompt: 一块蓝色PCB的单路继电器模块，俯视微侧视角，板上一个蓝色方形继电器本体，一个黑色光耦芯片，一颗红色指示灯，左侧三针排针，右侧一个三位绿色接线端子带螺丝
parts.what: Lets a tiny voltage switch a big appliance on and off — an electrically operated light switch

parts.name: part_hcsr04
parts.label: HC-SR04 ultrasonic
parts.prompt: 一块HC-SR04超声波测距模块，正面平视，蓝色长方形PCB上并排两个银色圆柱形超声换能器，每个换能器正面是细密的金属网格振膜而不是光滑旋钮，两个换能器之间有一个小晶振和一颗黑色贴片芯片，PCB底边伸出整齐的一排四根笔直的镀金方形排针
parts.what: Works like a bat: chirp, listen for the echo, compute the distance. The two silver eyes give it away

parts.name: part_keypad
parts.label: 4x4 membrane keypad
parts.prompt: 一块4x4薄膜矩阵键盘，正面平铺俯视，完全扁平的米白色薄膜面板没有任何凸起按键，表面用浅灰色线条印出四行四列共十六个方形按键区域，底部引出一条很细的扁平柔性排线，排线末端是一个整齐的单排八针黑色插头
parts.what: Sixteen keys on eight wires. Row-and-column scanning figures out which one you pressed

parts.name: part_sd_module
parts.label: SD card module
parts.prompt: 一块Micro SD卡读卡模块，俯视微侧视角，蓝色小PCB上有一个银色金属卡槽，旁边一颗黑色电平转换芯片和几个贴片元件，一侧一排六根直角排针
parts.what: Gives your board a hard drive — for logging sensor data, images or music

parts.name: part_stepper_28byj
parts.label: 28BYJ-48 stepper motor
parts.prompt: 一个28BYJ-48步进电机和它的驱动板放在一起，电机是银色圆柱体带蓝色塑料顶盖和一根短转轴，引出五色排线带白色插头；旁边一块绿色小PCB驱动板，板上一颗黑色长条ULN2003芯片、四颗红色指示灯和一个白色插座
parts.what: Turns one small step at a time, so you can hit an exact angle. Slow but precise

parts.name: part_ws2812
parts.label: WS2812 LED ring
parts.prompt: 一个WS2812B可编程LED灯环，正面俯视，黑色圆环形PCB上均匀排布十六颗白色方形贴片LED，其中几颗亮着红绿蓝不同颜色，背面引出三根线
parts.what: Every single LED can be its own color, all daisy-chained on one data wire

parts.name: part_power_18650
parts.label: 18650 battery + charger
parts.prompt: 一节蓝色外皮的18650锂电池，旁边一个黑色双节电池盒带红黑引线，还有一块蓝色的TP4056充电板，板上有Micro USB口、两颗红蓝指示灯和几组焊盘
parts.what: Cuts the USB cord. Buy cells with a built-in protection board

parts.name: part_power_adapter
parts.label: 5V power adapter
parts.prompt: 一个黑色的5V开关电源适配器，带两脚插头和一根黑色输出线，线端是DC圆头插头；旁边一个黑色DC5.5母座转接小板，带两个螺丝接线端子
parts.what: LED strips, motors and pumps are power-hungry — never draw them through the board's USB port

parts.name: part_dc_motor_l298n
parts.label: DC motor + L298N driver
parts.prompt: 一个黄色塑料外壳的TT直流减速电机带两根红黑引线和一个黄色塑料轮胎，旁边一块L298N电机驱动板，红色PCB上有一个黑色大散热片、绿色螺丝接线端子和一排排针
parts.what: Wheels for a robot car. The motor needs its own power supply, not the board's

parts.name: part_electrolytic_1000uf
parts.label: 1000μF electrolytic capacitor
parts.prompt: 一个1000微法的黑色圆柱形电解电容，侧前方视角，外壳有一条白色竖条纹标着负极，顶部有十字压痕，底部引出两根金属长脚，一根明显更长
parts.what: A little reservoir of current. Park one next to a servo or motor so the voltage does not sag

parts.name: part_ds18b20
parts.label: DS18B20 temperature probe
parts.prompt: 一个DS18B20防水温度探头，一段银色不锈钢圆柱形探头连着黑色防水导线，线的另一端分出红黑黄三根裸线
parts.what: Waterproof, so it can sit in liquid. The data line needs a 4.7kΩ pull-up resistor

parts.name: part_pump_diode
parts.label: 1N5819 flyback diode
parts.prompt: 一颗1N5819肖特基二极管，黑色圆柱形玻璃封装，一端有一道灰白色环标记负极，两端引出细长金属引脚，特写微距
parts.what: Motors and pumps kick back when switched off — this absorbs the kick and protects your board

parts.name: part_rtc_ds3231
parts.label: DS3231 real-time clock
parts.prompt: 一块DS3231实时时钟小板，蓝色长方形PCB，板上一颗黑色方形芯片、一个银色圆柱晶振和一个圆形纽扣电池座装着银色电池，一侧一排排针
parts.what: Remembers the time even with the power off — needed for timed feeders, alarms and schedules

parts.name: part_hc05
parts.label: HC-05 Bluetooth module
parts.prompt: 一块HC-05蓝牙串口模块，蓝色小PCB上覆盖一块银色金属屏蔽罩，罩上有锯齿状天线走线，板边一排六根排针，角上一颗红色指示灯和一个小按键
parts.what: The easiest way to send commands from your phone to the board

parts.name: part_ir_receiver
parts.label: IR receiver + remote
parts.prompt: 一个VS1838B红外接收头，黑色半球形透镜封装带三根金属引脚，旁边一个黑色的薄片红外遥控器，遥控器上有一排小圆按键
parts.what: Any remote lying around your house can now control the thing you built

parts.name: part_mosfet
parts.label: MOSFET driver module
parts.prompt: 一块MOS管驱动模块，蓝色小PCB上焊着一颗黑色TO-220封装的场效应管带银色散热片，板上两组绿色螺丝接线端子和一排排针，一颗红色指示灯
parts.what: Quieter than a relay and it can dim or throttle. Drives motors, LED strips and pumps

parts.name: part_mpu6050
parts.label: MPU6050 gyroscope
parts.prompt: 一块GY-521 MPU6050六轴传感器模块，紫色小PCB俯视，板中央一颗黑色方形芯片，一侧一排八根排针，板上有几个贴片电阻电容
parts.what: Knows how it is tilted and shaken — for orientation, step counting and self-balancing robots

parts.name: part_mq2
parts.label: MQ-2 smoke sensor
parts.prompt: 一块MQ-2气体传感器模块，蓝色PCB上立着一个圆柱形金属网罩包裹的传感器本体，旁边一颗电位器和两颗指示灯，底部一排四根排针
parts.what: Sniffs smoke and flammable gas. Needs to warm up before the readings mean anything

parts.name: part_pir
parts.label: PIR motion sensor
parts.prompt: 一个HC-SR501人体红外感应模块，正面是白色半球形菲涅尔透镜罩，背面绿色PCB上有两个橙色电位器、一个跳线帽和三根排针
parts.what: Goes high when a person moves nearby — for automatic lights and doorway alerts

parts.name: part_rain
parts.label: Rain sensor
parts.prompt: 一块雨滴传感器，一片长方形的黑色感应板表面印着密集的金色梳状走线，用两根杜邦线连到一块蓝色小比较器板，小板上有一颗电位器和四根排针
parts.what: Water landing on the board closes the circuit — for laundry alerts and auto-retracting awnings

parts.name: part_soil_moisture
parts.label: Soil moisture sensor
parts.prompt: 一个电容式土壤湿度传感器，一长条黑色防水PCB探针，上半部有电路和三根排针，下半部是光滑的插土部分，整体细长像一把小尺子
parts.what: The heart of any plant-watering project. Buy the capacitive kind — the resistive ones corrode away

parts.name: part_sound
parts.label: Sound sensor
parts.prompt: 一块声音传感器模块，蓝色小PCB上立着一个银色圆柱形驻极体麦克风，旁边一颗蓝色电位器、一颗芯片和两颗指示灯，底部一排排针
parts.what: Clap-to-turn-on lights, or lights that dance with the music

parts.name: part_water_pump
parts.label: Mini submersible pump
parts.prompt: 一个微型潜水泵，黑色圆柱形塑料泵体带一个侧向出水嘴和底部进水格栅，引出两根红黑细线，旁边盘着一段透明硅胶软管
parts.what: For watering and refilling. Never wire it straight to a pin — go through a relay or MOSFET
